profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer (AI) at FreeWheel
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer with two decades of enterprise engineering experience, most of it at Yahoo (formerly AOL / Verizon Media) — building and modernizing high-scale platforms, leading engineering teams, and staying hands-on across Java backend services, REST APIs, and ad-tech integrations.
Recently expanded into AI and agentic development, integrating AI into my engineering workflow in ways that meaningfully accelerate what I can deliver.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Google Ad Manager APIs · Relational Databases · SQL · REST APIs · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Technical Design · Anthropic Claude · Java · Claude Code · Git · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Model Context Protocol (MCP) · Agentic AI Development

positions.title: Senior Technical Manager
positions.description: Led a high-performing engineering team across 15+ microservices while maintaining active hands-on Java development contributions, conducting technical interviews, interfacing with product and support teams, and driving technical decisions

positions.title: Senior Technical Manager
positions.description: Note: Verizon Media sold to Apollo Global Management in 2021 and rebranded as Yahoo

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Promoted to Principal Software Engineer ahead of transitioning into an engineering management role. Continued hands-on Java development across backend services and shared platform libraries.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: AngularJS · MyBatis · Relational Databases · Oracle Database · Gradle · Angular · HTML · Jira · Agile Methodologies · Jenkins · JAX-RS · JavaScript · Java

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack engineer on the Business Intelligence and Automation team — developed internal tools and reporting systems using Java, SQL, HTML, ExtJS, and Tomcat. Owned the full application lifecycle from end-user requirements through deployment.
Note: AOL acquired by Verizon Media in 2015
positions.insights: Skills: MyBatis · Relational Databases · SQL · Tomcat · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · MySQL · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Microsoft SQL Server · Ext JS · Java

positions.title: Information Technology Specialist / Consultant
positions.description: Contracted to a public sector client to design and implement an automated test suite for an Oracle OBIEE reporting subsystem, using Java, Rational Functional Tester, SQL, and XML to improve build validation efficiency.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed data-driven web applications supporting critical military defense systems using Java, SQL, XML, XPath, JavaScript, and CSS.
positions.insights: Skills: XML · SQL · XSLT · Code Review · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Java · Requirements Gathering

positions.title: Software Developer/Engineer
positions.description: Wrote test plans and automated scripts to ensure seamless installation and system integration in lower environments for over 30+ servers.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · Test Planning · Perl · Shell Scripting · Technical Documentation · Integration Testing
